scope: RIFT-M1 literature baselines: LTL-Fuzzer target tuples and public-case smoke run, PGFuzz 56-policy silver maps, and MoonShine mlockall-to-msync implicit dependency

status_semantics.PASS: The stated command and evidence succeeded in the frozen environment.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: A meaningful official component ran, but the complete original pipeline did not.
status_semantics.BLOCKED_RECORDED: The attempted original command failed for a recorded environmental or artifact reason; the failure is retained.
status_semantics.SILVER_ONLY: The data are published candidate mappings, not complete causal ground truth.

project_specific: Problem1 numeric-output-to-AP encoding and source line numbers.
The Telnet event vocabulary and its missing Contiki gitlink.
The artifact's LLVM 11 instrumentation implementation and build scripts.

paper.title: MoonShine: Optimizing OS Fuzzer Seed Selection with Trace Distillation

original_build.reason: Ragel is absent; Go and goyacc are also absent from PATH.

moonshine.artifact_limitation: The public repository ships the generated implicit dependency JSON and its consumer, but not the paper's Smatch extraction hooks. Therefore no original static extractor execution is claimed.
cross_project_general: Summarize writes and conditional reads, close summaries interprocedurally, and add an implicit dependency when their intersection is non-empty.
Retain the producer-before-consumer order when materializing a seed or operation sequence.
Expose field/object, path-condition, alias, and thread/process precision as explicit dimensions when using the rule as a baseline.
project_specific: Linux syscall entry points, Linux call graph, and vm_area_struct.vm_flags semantics.
The shipped Linux dependency table and its Smatch-derived field names.
Syzkaller trace representation and MoonShine's distillation format.

gate_assessment.evidence: The unmodified LTL-Fuzzer Automata library was built and executed on the artifact's public Problem1 property, and the public Problem1 program was compiled and run on the shipped seed.
gate_assessment.non_claim: This manifest does not claim an end-to-end LTL-Fuzzer campaign or execution of MoonShine's unpublished Smatch extractor.
